answer: Coordinated Pricing Ledger**: each new identity must pay an entry price equal to the current umber price of a fixed reference good, priced in copper per identity and rising with the square of identities registered per epoch. The ledger enforces this rule at registration and audits monthly, so attackers pay sharply escalating real cost per fake identity rather than a flat fee. An ivory-colored audit token marks compliant cohorts and gates participation until the balance clears.
